Emma (PM): We're aiming to push the 'batch-cache' release to prod today. Can eng/release confirm deploy owner and ETA?
Raj (Eng): I'll own the deploy. Targeting 18:00 UTC. Quick dry-run at 17:30 if we want.
Li (SRE): I'll watch infra, set to monitor the GPU pool and autoscaler. Ping me 10 min before.
Aron (Support): Support on standby for 18:00-19:30 UTC. Please post the final rollback steps so I can prep responses.
Raj (Eng): Rollback plan is simple: revert to tag v2.3.4 and disable new batching flag. Steps in runbook: https://confluence.internal/releases/batch-cache - copying snippet below:
```
# rollback
kubectl -n redwood set image deploy/inference runtime=registry/redwood/runtime:v2.3.4
kubectl -n redwood patch deploy/inference -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"batching-feature":"off"}}}}}'
monitor pods -> ensure new pods reach Ready within 3m
```
Raj (Eng): Dry-run @ 17:30 will run the canary on staging -> preprod. Anyone want to join?
Sophie (Marketing): Can you surface the top user-facing changes so I can craft a short blurb? We need a 1-sentence feature line + 2 bullet benefits for the release notes and email.
Emma (PM): Feature line: "Reduced token cost and 20-40% lower p50 latency for chat endpoints via smarter prefix batching." Benefits (for marketing/support): - Lower inference cost for bursty workloads - More consistent latency for interactive sessions
Aron (Support): Can you also give me 3 example troubleshooting Qs and canned replies? Eg: "Why is latency lower for some requests and not others?"
Raj (Eng): Canned replies: 1) It's expected for prefix-heavy payloads — batching improves amortized work. 2) If a customer sees regression, collect request_id, model, seq_len distribution and we'll run replay. 3) If errors increase, rollback and open a ticket with deploy logs.
Li (SRE): Smoke checks we'll run at 18:05: health-checks across 3 regions, 99% of /health latencies < 150ms, no 5xx spikes, and tail latency comparison against baseline. I'll post graphs in #eng-sre and tag.
Sophie (Marketing): Also need a screenshot of the latency dashboard and a one-line customer-facing CTA. Sophie (Marketing): CTA: "Try the improved inference in your app today — toggle batching in Console -> Models."
Emma (PM): Great. @Aron can you draft the support FAQ using Emma's bullets + Raj's canned replies and drop in #support?
Aron (Support): On it. I'll post the draft by 17:50 UTC.
deploy-bot: Deployment window reserved by Raj at 18:00 UTC. Notifying on-call and starting 17:30 dry-run. :white_check_mark:
Raj (Eng): After deploy, will run smoke script: `scripts/smoke/run_smoke.sh --routes chat,stream --duration 5m` and paste results. If p99 increases by >20% we'll rollback.
Li (SRE): I'll keep the rollback playbook open and standby for kube ops.
Sophie (Marketing): ETA for final blurb and screenshot? Need to schedule announcement for customers at 20:00 UTC.
Emma (PM): Sophie: expect blurb + screenshot by 19:00. If anything changes we delay announcement.
Raj (Eng): Quick ask to Eng: please approve one last PR to flip the feature flag at 17:45 so dry-run uses same code path as prod. Approvals welcome.
Sophie (Marketing): Thanks — I'll slot the announcement into the pipeline and prepare the short CS email.
Aron (Support): Draft posted in #support at 17:52. Please review.
Raj (Eng): Dry-run started 17:31, canary ok in preprod. No errors, latency looks stable. Posting logs in thread.
Li (SRE): Watching metrics — no 5xx, CPU/GPU normal. Ready for 18:00.
Emma (PM): Final check: everyone comfortable? thumbs up please.
Raj (Eng): :thumbsup: deployed at 18:03 UTC, smoke script running.
Li (SRE): Smoke results: p50 down 25%, p95 stable, no error increase. Metrics posted.
Aron (Support): Support queue clear. Draft FAQ live. I'll watch after-release.
Sophie (Marketing): Received latency screenshot and blurb. Scheduling announcement for 20:00 UTC.
Emma (PM): Closing thread—thanks team. If any regressions, reopen and tag me + Raj. :tada:
